| R.1 | A person with valid credentials can sign in and reach the home page | `foyer-core.feature` › Sign in with valid credentials<br>`navbar-role-label.feature` › Admin role label is shown in the navbar |
| R.2 | Invalid credentials are rejected with a visible error and no sign-in | `foyer-core.feature` › Invalid credentials are rejected<br>`navbar-role-label.feature` › Regular user role label is shown in the navbar |

| R.4 | The home page shows the welcome banner with the default message | `foyer-core.feature` › Home page shows the default welcome banner |
| R.5 | The home page greets the signed-in person by the name derived from their email | `foyer-core.feature` › Home page greets the signed-in person |
